digest.component_or_area: llm model class resolution and provider qualifying
propositions: a configured provider is silently discarded when a model id contains a colon, because the colon-presence test cannot distinguish between provider separators and colons within model version suffixes
canonical versioned Bedrock ids in the form 'us.anthropic.claude-...-v1:0' are affected while unversioned aliases work, masking the defect
infer_provider incorrectly returns a fragment of the model id instead of the actual provider when a colon is present in a non-qualified string
two independent implementations of the same qualified/unqualified decision in _resolve_target and infer_provider can drift apart, causing inconsistent behavior across callers
the error message blames an inferred provider fragment rather than the actual misconfiguration, confusing operators about whether the provider is registered
an explicitly configured provider must be checked before any scan of the model string, to prevent punctuation from overruling explicit instructions
